name: clipId
label: Clip ID
help: The clip to export, as it looks when this module runs. Get clip IDs from Make an API call with GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/clips.

name: aspectRatios
label: Formats
help: Each format is rendered as its own file.

name: resolution
label: Resolution
help: A plan that does not include 1080p exports at 720p, and says so in Granted resolution.

name: runKey
label: Run key
help: Narriflow remembers a request for good, so the same inputs are the same request forever. An edit to the clip is a new export on its own. Map the trigger's Event ID here to run once for each event.
